doc.name: atelier-store
doc.instructions: A store of original photographs sold under a personal-use license, and some under a commercial one too. Searching needs no account; the first account tool (get_account and the others that spend or download) asks the person to sign in by email, so tell them before you call it. Search with search_images, passing the destination screen size when there is one, then show the person the previews and let them choose. A host that supports MCP Apps draws the pictures for the person; others show them nothing, so there give them each result's preview_url as a link to open. Buying spends the image's price in credits (price.credits — not always 1): check get_account first, and confirm with the person before calling fulfil_image. The free trial is 3 credits, once per person and only before they have paid for anything (get_account says trial_available): offer start_trial only when it would buy the image they chose — price.credits no more than that, and price.trial_credits_accepted true. An image bought with trial credits comes as the screen file only; its print file can be bought afterwards at the full price (fulfil_image with buy_print: true, in paid credits, or by card). Anything the buyer already owns (owned: true in results once signed in) re-downloads free. For more credits, or to pay for one image by card where price.card_available is true, create_checkout returns a link for them to open — never ask anyone for card details. After they pay for an image by card, fulfil_image delivers it without spending credits. The personal license does not cover business use. When the person wants an image for a business, a client, marketing, advertising or anything sold, they need the commercial license: offered only where price.commercial is not null (search_images with licence: "commercial" finds those), bought by card with create_checkout kind=one_off licence=commercial, and never with credits, the trial or a subscription. Ask what the image is for when it is unclear, and read get_licence code=commercial before recommending it. If the person has a private gallery's link and access code from a photographer, unlock_collection opens it to their account. Every image names its photographer; the license asks for credit where practical, so pass the name on with the file. A bought image comes as a screen file and a full-resolution print file; the person can download them again at any time from the account_url that get_account returns. There, too, they cancel or change a subscription, disconnect you, or delete their data; you cannot do those for them.

tools.name: search_images
tools.title: Search the image catalogue
tools.description: Find images for sale by description, mood, colour or subject — a plain description of the feeling or scene works as well as a keyword, so pass what the person actually said. Give target_width and target_height when the image is destined for a specific screen — results are then ranked by how close each frame is to that shape, and frames whose shape is badly wrong for it (a landscape frame for a phone) are left out. Images are sold as the photographer framed them, never cropped. Returns a preview of each image. Use get_image for one listing you already have the id of; use list_collections to browse rather than search.

query.description: Free text: subject, mood, colour, setting.

target_width.description: Destination width in pixels, e.g. 1290 for an iPhone. Give both or neither.

target_height.description: Destination height in pixels, e.g. 2796. Give both or neither.

collection_id.description: Restrict to one collection from list_collections.

licence.description: "commercial" for only the images that can be licensed for business use. Every image has the personal license.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, unchanged, with the same query and filters. Cannot be combined with target_width/target_height.

include_previews.description: Set false for metadata only, which is much cheaper.

tools.name: get_image
tools.title: Get one image
tools.description: Everything known about a single listing: its description, keywords, price in credits and money, the license it sells under, and a preview. Use after search_images when the person wants a closer look at one option.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.title: List collections
tools.description: The collections available in the store, with how many images are in each. Use for browsing when there is no particular search in mind; prefer search_images when the person has described what they want.

tools.name: get_licence
tools.title: Read the license
tools.description: The full terms an image is sold under: what the buyer may and may not do with it. Read this before recommending a purchase, and whenever the person asks what they are allowed to do with an image. "personal" (the default) is what credits and a card one-off buy; "commercial" is the business licence, sold by card where price.commercial is offered.

code.description: One of: personal, commercial. Omit for personal.

version.description: Omit for the terms currently on offer. Pass a version to read what was sold earlier.

tools.name: unlock_collection
tools.title: Unlock a private collection
tools.description: Open a PRIVATE collection to the signed-in buyer, using the address and access code its photographer gave them — for example a wedding or client gallery whose pictures are also for sale. Afterwards search_images, get_image and list_collections include it for this buyer, and its images can be bought like any other. Use it only with a code the person gave you; never guess one. Requires sign-in.

gallery.description: The gallery's address as the person has it, e.g. https://example.com/jane/smith-wedding, or "jane/smith-wedding".

access_code.description: The access code the photographer gave the person.

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Check the signed-in account
tools.description: The signed-in buyer: their credit balance, subscription status, how many images they already own, and whether a free trial is still available. Call this before proposing a purchase, so you know what they can already afford. Requires sign-in.

tools.name: start_trial
tools.title: Start the free trial
tools.description: Give the signed-in buyer 3 credits free, once per email address, ever, and never to an account that has paid here. Offer it when get_account says trial_available, someone wants an image, has no credits and has not tried the store before — AND the trial would buy that image: its price.credits is no more than 3 and price.trial_credits_accepted is true. Otherwise the trial is spent on nothing they wanted. Trial credits buy the screen file only — tell the person, so a print is not expected; the print can be bought afterwards at the full price. Requires sign-in.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.title: Start a purchase the person completes themselves
tools.description: Return a payment link for the person to open in a browser: either a subscription plan, or a single image bought outright (only where price.card_available is true) — or that image's commercial license, with licence=commercial, where price.commercial is not null. The commercial license is sold only this way; Stripe's page asks the person to name the licensee. THE AGENT NEVER HANDLES CARD DETAILS and must not ask for any — hand the url over and let the person pay on the payment page. Nothing is granted until they finish. After a one-off, call fulfil_image with the same listing_id: once the payment has landed it delivers the image at no credit cost, and until then it answers payment_pending. After a subscription, get_account shows it. Every result lists the plans with their prices. Use fulfil_image instead when the buyer already has credits or already owns the image, and start_trial when they have none and have not tried the store. Refused when the buyer already owns the image or already has a subscription, so that nobody pays twice — except an image the free trial bought, which is the screen file only: a one-off for it buys the print file at the full price. Each new link cancels the previous one — any earlier subscription link, or an earlier link for the same image — so give the person only the latest.

plan_code.description: For kind=subscription. Call with kind=subscription and no plan_code to list the plans and their prices.

listing_id.description: For kind=one_off: the image to buy outright.

licence.description: For kind=one_off. "commercial" buys the business licence, by card only; omit for personal.

tools.name: fulfil_image
tools.title: Get an image the buyer is entitled to
tools.description: Deliver an image to the signed-in buyer, spending the image's price in credits (price.credits in search_images and get_image — often 1, sometimes more) if they do not already own it. Credits buy the personal license only; the commercial license is bought with create_checkout, and this then delivers it. If they DO already own it this is free and always will be — use it freely for re-downloads, and for a fresh download link. The purchased image comes as two links, both as the photographer framed it, uncropped: download_url, 2560px WebP on the long side, which a phone or desktop fits to its own screen as a wallpaper; and print_url, the original file at full resolution (often 10–35 MB), for printing (null when unavailable). Give the person both; they expire at download_expires_at, a day out, and their account page (account_url in get_account) lists every image they own with fresh links. The picture returned inline is a 1200px copy to show them what they got. Pass full_image: true to have the full file inline as well — often 1–3 MB — only if you can accept a result that large and save it yourself. Confirm the price with the person before spending credits. An image bought wholly with free-trial credits is the screen file only: print_url is null, print_included false, and print_offer says what the print costs — the full price again, in paid credits. With the person's agreement, call again with buy_print: true to spend them (or create_checkout kind=one_off to pay by card). After a card checkout for this image it spends nothing: it answers payment_pending until the payment lands, then delivers. Requires sign-in.

full_image.description: Also return the full 2560px file inline. Large; see the description.

abandon_checkout.description: Only after payment_pending, and only when the person has said they will not pay by card: cancels the open payment link and spends credits instead.

buy_print.description: For an image the free trial bought (print_included false): buy its print file, spending print_offer.credits of PAID credit. Only with the person's agreement.

tools.name: list_entitlements
tools.title: List images the buyer owns
tools.description: Everything the signed-in buyer has bought, newest first. Re-downloading any of them with fulfil_image costs nothing. Pass include_previews: true whenever the person wants to see their library: small pictures (at most 12 per page) without a fulfil_image per image. Requires sign-in.

include_previews.description: A small picture of each image. Caps the page at 12.

prompts.name: phone_wallpaper
prompts.title: Find a phone wallpaper
prompts.description: A portrait photograph that fits a phone screen, in the mood you describe.

arguments.name: look
arguments.description: What it should feel like, e.g. "calm, moody and minimal, a deep teal seascape at night".

prompts.name: desktop_background
prompts.title: Find a desktop background
prompts.description: A wide photograph that fits a computer screen, in the mood you describe.

arguments.name: look
arguments.description: What it should feel like, e.g. "warm golden-hour mountains, not too busy".

arguments.name: screen
arguments.description: Which screen, e.g. "MacBook Air" or "2560×1440 monitor".

prompts.name: print_for_home
prompts.title: Find a photo to print for your home
prompts.description: A landscape photograph to print large for a room, checked for print size and licence.

arguments.name: room
arguments.description: The room and the feeling, e.g. "my bright, airy living room: light, calm and open, soft blues and pale sand, coastal if you have it".

resources.name: Personal use license v1
resources.description: Use the image on your own devices and personal projects, forever. No resale, no redistribution, no commercial use, no AI training.

resources.name: Personal use license v2
resources.description: Use the image on your own devices and in personal projects, with no expiry. Credit the photographer where practical. No resale, no redistribution, no commercial use, no AI training.

resources.name: Commercial use license v1
resources.description: Use the image to promote and run a business — websites, social media, advertising, marketing and client work — with no expiry. Licensed to one named person or business. No merchandise or templates for resale, no redistribution, no AI training.

resources.name: Photographs
resources.description: The search results and images, drawn for the person.
